crossModuleWorkflows.workflow: Registration → reception → OPD → diagnosis → prescription → dispensing → billing → receipt
tracedSourceChain: billing outbox → charge recovery → finalized invoice → payment/receipt
crossModuleWorkflows.firstUnresolvedLink: First evidence boundary: concurrent registration/duplicate-policy and real role handoff have not been freshly reaccepted. First confirmed functional gap in the extended pharmacy loop: patient return/reversal policy/chain, not initial dispensing.
crossModuleWorkflows.downstreamConsequences: Cannot certify a single patient journey or complete price/receipt correctness by adding isolated tests; failed billing work may remain pending.
crossModuleWorkflows.requiredEndToEndProof: One synthetic patient through normal staff role logins; persist IDs across every handoff; dispense partially twice, interrupt billing and retry, settle by approved channel, inspect exact receipt/source-to-GL.

crossModuleWorkflows.workflow: OPD/lab order → specimen → result → verification → clinical access → billing
crossModuleWorkflows.firstUnresolvedLink: Official report issue: builder accepts any recorded result and only warns about unverified rows; approved final-release boundary missing. Earlier ordering/specimen/verification source exists.
crossModuleWorkflows.linkClassification: DEFECTIVE final-output eligibility (source-confirmed; no fresh DB exploit)
crossModuleWorkflows.downstreamConsequences: Unverified preliminary values may be issued as ordinary Laboratory Report; does not prove current production exposure. Clinical release/billing UAT remains incomplete.
crossModuleWorkflows.requiredEndToEndProof: Order exact panel/sample; test duplicate/wrong patient, mixed verification, premature PDF denial, approved final result access and exactly-once charge/recovery.

crossModuleWorkflows.workflow: Radiology request → consent → performed study → report → clinical access → billing
crossModuleWorkflows.firstUnresolvedLink: Consent/performance controls exist; final issue checks reportedAt OR findings, not the approved performed/released final state.
crossModuleWorkflows.downstreamConsequences: A findings-only record can satisfy printable eligibility; consent presence metadata is not cryptographic signer proof; no proof of a deployed bypass.
crossModuleWorkflows.requiredEndToEndProof: Request with no charge, deny generic/missing consent, verify specific procedure or audited exception, perform/report, gate final issue, bill once and test canceled/unperformed negative cases.

crossModuleWorkflows.workflow: Admission → bed allocation → ward services → pharmacy/lab charges → discharge → final invoice
tracedSourceChain: service charges and occupancy billing policy/recovery
crossModuleWorkflows.firstUnresolvedLink: Cross-department all-charge readiness and discharge/finalization barrier not proven; summary PDF requires text only and does not enforce discharged state.
crossModuleWorkflows.linkClassification: PARTIAL chain; DEFECTIVE final-summary issue contract
crossModuleWorkflows.downstreamConsequences: Final discharge package may omit pending charges or be issued before approved discharge; bed rules cannot be inferred from a summary.
crossModuleWorkflows.requiredEndToEndProof: Occupied bed/ward transfer/midnight/same-day case with medication/lab services and failed billing retry; finalization policy checks pending work; exact summary/invoice/receipt and old occupancy retained.

crossModuleWorkflows.workflow: Pharmacy purchase → GRN → stock/lot balance → dispensing → billing → inventory reports
crossModuleWorkflows.firstUnresolvedLink: No freshly accepted complete costed opening/receipt→lot→dispense→movement/GL→report tie-out; recorded movement report deliberately lacks verified historical opening/closing valuation.
crossModuleWorkflows.linkClassification: UNVERIFIED costed chain; PARTIAL broad stock report
crossModuleWorkflows.downstreamConsequences: Cannot infer inventory valuation/profit/complete balances from current stock or per-item signed movement nets; different units never added.
crossModuleWorkflows.requiredEndToEndProof: Two items/different units, partial receipts/split lots/expiry/retry; reconcile received less dispensed/returns to lots/item/movements and accepted GL; compare full saved report files.

crossModuleWorkflows.workflow: Requisition → approval → LPO → GRN → supplier AP → payment → accounting
crossModuleWorkflows.firstUnresolvedLink: No missing generic AP/payment service found. First unresolved evidence link is approved role/threshold/contract configuration and complete real-browser chain, including mismatch override.
crossModuleWorkflows.downstreamConsequences: Old reports saying supplier invoices/payments are absent are wrong; existence still does not prove approved supplier terms, payable/GL correctness or UAT.
crossModuleWorkflows.requiredEndToEndProof: One approved requisition/PO with partial GRN, invoice variance, independent approved override, partial/full settlement and return/credit; exact AP/clearing/stock/GL and document evidence; duplicate/concurrent denial.

crossModuleWorkflows.workflow: Invoice → payment → receipt → reviewed journal → ledger → statements
crossModuleWorkflows.firstUnresolvedLink: Receipt→reviewed GL is an explicit separate controlled action, not automatic atomic full-system settlement. Complete posting coverage and mappings are not accepted.
crossModuleWorkflows.linkClassification: PARTIAL accepted-accounting scope; UNVERIFIED whole chain
crossModuleWorkflows.downstreamConsequences: Recorded collections can differ from posted cash/AR/revenue until review; balanced journal alone does not validate recognition/classification; no cash-flow product.
crossModuleWorkflows.requiredEndToEndProof: Known invoice with patient/insurer allocation and partial payment/refund; interrupt between receipt and reviewed journal; diagnostics expose gap; safe retry, reversal and posted statement/control-account reconciliation.

crossModuleWorkflows.workflow: Annual financial budget → actual financial performance → variance
tracedSourceChain: posted journals and accounting reports exist separately
no approved financial budget-line/account/department actual mapping
crossModuleWorkflows.firstUnresolvedLink: Financial budget line → correctly scoped recognized posted actual is not implemented/approved.
crossModuleWorkflows.downstreamConsequences: No honest budget-versus-actual result; projection, zero assumption or arbitrary department revenue cannot be substituted.
crossModuleWorkflows.requiredEndToEndProof: Approved budget revision and independently posted sample period; account/department mappings, unposted sources and signed variance convention; source drill-down and PDF/XLSX parity.

crossModuleWorkflows.workflow: Procurement plan → approved procurement → actual purchases → plan comparison
crossModuleWorkflows.firstUnresolvedLink: Plan/version/source line → approved procurement/receipt/invoice attribution is missing.
crossModuleWorkflows.downstreamConsequences: Planned quantities cannot become stock/purchases/expense automatically; commitment, received, invoiced and paid bases need separate approved meanings.
crossModuleWorkflows.requiredEndToEndProof: Approved plan with partial real purchases/returns; explicit source links and basis; exact remaining commitments/actual/variance, no duplicate cost and original plan/import bytes unchanged.

crossModuleWorkflows.workflow: Patient document upload → authorization → portal release → secure viewing
tracedSourceChain: patient-documents permission and explicit release per version
portal session scoped list/file + access audit
crossModuleWorkflows.firstUnresolvedLink: No missing basic upload/release/view link found in current source. First unresolved boundary is client release/retention/signer policy and fresh same-build multi-patient DB/browser reacceptance.
crossModuleWorkflows.linkClassification: PARTIAL owner acceptance; historically synthetic end-to-end supported
crossModuleWorkflows.downstreamConsequences: Do not reimplement file storage from older missing-feature claims; uploaded content still needs staff review and old released versions need explicit withdrawal after correction.
crossModuleWorkflows.requiredEndToEndProof: Two patient/two facility normal logins; original-byte match, unsafe/oversized upload refusal, explicit release/withdrawal, correction version isolation, no staff metadata, failed mandatory audit denies file bytes.

crossModuleWorkflows.workflow: Report generation → facility/date filters → PDF/XLSX export → active letterhead
tracedSourceChain: saved historical actual browser PDFs/XLSX incl Batch1
crossModuleWorkflows.firstUnresolvedLink: For the 28 supported partial entries the bounded path exists; for the other116 catalogue labels the first missing link is query/workflow integration or approved source/business definitions.
crossModuleWorkflows.downstreamConsequences: Cannot claim all144 reports; stock movement net not balance/valuation, posted income not cash settlement; unavailable document navigation may coexist with owning-module PDF.
crossModuleWorkflows.requiredEndToEndProof: Each approved engine/workflow independently seeded across tenant/facility/date boundaries; ordinary login/actual download, compare every required cell/page/header/full filtered result and active/historical/fallback stationery.

roadmapPhases.title: Baseline, critical security, data integrity and access control
roadmapPhases.dependencies: D01–D05: named sponsor/security/data-controller/role owners; accessible full CI artifacts and approved disposable PostgreSQL16/Docker. Establish D15 recovery/host owners now. Requirements discovery and provider onboarding may run in parallel, not be postponed until their phase.
deliverables: Signed original-requirement/source inventory or explicit unresolved-original scope hold; no invented workbook contents or client phase assumptions.
Private owner-led incident disposition plan/evidence; no unauthorized Git history cleanup, production access or exposure in reports.
Required staff password-change restriction, agreed usable MFA/recovery, complete mounted-route/module/scope/role audit and document access/mandatory audit policy.
Reproducible green same-revision full CI/database/coverage/fresh-bootstrap candidate; investigate0095 guarded-DDL governance without editing applied history or bypassing tests.
Early current-schema restore feasibility proof and documented escalation for binary/immutable audit/consistency concerns; final off-host/RPO/RTO certification remains phase7.
tests: Existing/new direct HTTP scope/role/disabled-module/flagged-password/pre-MFA/revoked-session/foreign-ID negatives using disposable fixtures; no production login testing.
Mandatory audit failure injection for sensitive data/output; no unauthorized bytes and safe logs.
All configured CI jobs on same candidate; every required attested DB test executes. Preserve a failed gate until resolved; no skip/regex relaxation as cosmetic fix.
roadmapPhases.exit: Security owner signs dispositions and required control evidence; no unresolved exploitable critical gate in included paths; CI is genuinely green; exact requirement source/scope holds are visible and owned. No declaration of incident closure without owner evidence.
roadmapPhases.deferred: No clinical feature expansion, financial rule guessing or provider/live activation here. Optional features remain outside contract until approved.

roadmapPhases.title: Complete included patient and clinical journeys as integrated workflows
roadmapPhases.dependencies: Phase1 security/green candidate; D03/D05/D06 approved clinical departments, catalogue/protocols, role/consent/release/retention policy; D07 terminology decisions where applicable. D02 originals needed for specific clinical templates.
deliverables: Accepted registration/MRN/duplicate identity→reception/appointment→OPD/history/diagnosis/prescription/referral flow, including all directory pages and late-response safety.
Specimen/accession→result→verification→authorized final lab issue; procedure-specific radiology consent→performance/report→approved final access, with explicit drafts and immutable corrections.

Nursing/admission/bed handoff and required eMAR/treatment chart; approved maternity/MCH/dialysis clinical scope; theatre execution/dental consumption/specialties/emergency/custody departments only as signed included requirements.
Secure original file upload/correction→explicit per-version portal release→own-patient viewing and approved sharing/withdrawal. Do not rebuild already existing storage/letterhead/consent systems.
Correct coding-system/release provenance in clinical and payer snapshots; preserve historical codes without automatic conversion.
tests: WF-01 clinical portion; WF-02,WF-03 andWF-10 through normal staff/patient logins with real PostgreSQL and native saved document inspection.

Wrong patient/order/encounter, shared contact/minor identity, duplicate accession, mixed verification, generic/wrong-order consent, revoked grant, unsafe file, correction/old release and mandatory audit failure.
Clinical owner scenario walkthrough for every included specialty, with immutable version/signature metadata and no automatic unperformed-care completion.
roadmapPhases.exit: Clinical/lab/radiology/pharmacy/nursing/records owners approve persisted same-patient handoffs and source-specific issue eligibility; no open required clinical NOT IMPLEMENTED/DEFECTIVE row. Any excluded department has a signed contractual decision retained in register.
roadmapPhases.deferred: Provider electronic submission and actual financial valuation wait for their contracts; clinical acceptance is not statutory/legal/provider certification. Do not defer an included mandatory ward/theatre/blood-bank safety flow merely because it is large.

roadmapPhases.title: Billing and financial transaction integrity across care delivery
roadmapPhases.dependencies: Phase2 accepted events; D06/D08 approved service/medicine prices, payment methods, bed-night/recognition/refund/waiver rules; signed role/approver staffing. D11 owner-approved manual bank evidence inputs, not necessarily bank API credentials.
deliverables: All included clinical events create exactly-once charge evidence, with durable pending/unpriced/retry/cancel states.
Invoice immutable finalization and patient/insurer allocation; receipts only after approved channel settlement, manual bank declaration→independent verification→independent settlement.
Correct partial dispensing/returns and snapshot medicine prices; bed occupancy/rate/cutoff/same-day and all-service discharge reconciliation.
Refund/credit/waiver distinctions with exact independent source evidence; accepted manual payer preparation/claims and separately recorded receipt reconciliation.
tests: WF-01 care-to-receipt, WF-03 billing, WF-04 complete discharge billing; multi-actor normal-login DB/browser scenarios.

Unpriced service, price changes after dispense, same-day/midnight/transfer, simultaneous posting, uncertain response/retry, overpayment, patient vs insurer, wrong/self-approver, reused bank evidence, overrefund and canceled-care negatives.
Actual finalized invoice/receipt/refund output matches accepted cents/payer/source and branding; deferred GL reviewed-posting gap remains visible.
roadmapPhases.exit: Every included clinical source reconciles to one approved charge; accepted payment/refund is atomic/idempotent and correct-party; no declaration/method label can manufacture settlement; clinical and finance owners sign end-to-end transaction truth.
roadmapPhases.deferred: Bank/M-Pesa API settlement is not assumed by manual verification; advanced credit products need signed design, not reuse of a printed refund title.

roadmapPhases.title: Procurement, inventory, assets, accounting and planning-to-actual completion
roadmapPhases.dependencies: Phases1–3; D02/D06/D08/D16 original sources, units/openings/costs/chart/periods/account classifications/supplier policies, budget bases, equity formula/identity and approved tax decisions. D07 for payroll and tax.
deliverables: WF-06 whole requisition→approval→LPO→GRN→match→AP→pay/returns with approved source documents and independent approval/variance controls.
Costed lot/item/location/movement/GL reconciliation including pharmacy/dialysis/ward/dental producers; governed stores where required; do not infer historical balances from recorded movements.
Reviewed source→journal→ledger/control accounts with complete coverage and gap recovery; approved statements and cash flow; accepted cash management only where included.
Fixed-asset procurement handoff, opening register/physical verification and lifecycle; preserve narrow accepted depreciation arithmetic.

Retained original planning imports/source-row/default provenance and safe CRUD/reset; separate approved financial budget, procurement plan and actual records. Implement explicit source links/actual mappings and financial/procurement variances.

Partner equity original cells/nulls/history/provisional precision preserved; approve original formula and facility identity before final finance acceptance. Required HR/payroll/chart/rules reviewed without guessing statutory rates.
tests: WF-05,WF-06,WF-07,WF-08,WF-09 using independent expected cents/quantities; two facilities/two tenants, failure rollback, concurrent retry, closed periods and immutability.
Received/returned/dispensed/count/transfer quantities agree across lots/items/movements; accepted cost basis and AP/stock/AR/cash/GL controls reconcile with no unexplained differences.
Approved plan revision vs partial commitment/GRN/invoice/payment/posted-actual basis; zero vs unknown preserved; full saved PDF/XLSX and independent finance fixture review.
Original source tests run with authorized originals, no skips/synthetic substitutions; safe reset tests only disposable drafts and preserve imported bytes/audit/actuals.
roadmapPhases.exit: Finance/stores/procurement/HR owners sign source-to-control/GL and actual-variance mappings; all included financial/stock/asset/plan figures trace to accepted records, not projected guesses; independent workbook/policy fixtures exact.
roadmapPhases.deferred: Uncontracted multi-currency/consolidation/advanced forecasts not invented. Original formula/actual policy gaps cannot be closed by balancing cents, zero filling undisclosed unknowns, or declaring a model actual.

roadmapPhases.title: Required reporting, statutory outputs and issued-document branding
roadmapPhases.dependencies: Correct accepted sources from phases2–4; D03/D09/D10 signed output shortlist/definitions/templates/issue policy; D07/D12 authoritative statutory forms/versions. Continue existing Reporting Centre only.
deliverables: Resolve each included catalogue output CAT-001–CAT-144 against its explicit source/period/denominator/status/null semantics; unchanged unavailable labels remain honest until accepted or contractually deferred.
Common scope/date/selection/filter/export parity and active/historical/fallback letterhead across all included report kinds.
Preserved issue-time body/version/history per approved document policy and authorized stamps/signers; no decorative signature falsely authenticated.
Finance/management/audit reports, MCH outputs and approved MOH/payroll forms using complete sources; formal national transmission remains phase6.
tests: WF-11 for every included output: real DB/HTTP/source arithmetic/scope/date/empty/error/permission tests, actual normal-login browser and native downloads.

Parse each saved PDF/XLSX against every required row/total and full filtered scope; check no unauthorized metadata, exact currencies/unknowns, active template/version/page count and representative visual pages.
Two-facility A/B activation and historical reprint cases, no-template fallback, >page-size and export-limit refusal; source-specific clinical official-release negatives and statutory gold fixtures.
roadmapPhases.exit: Each included client-required output COMPLETE with owner sign-off and saved-artifact evidence; remaining144 catalogue candidates retain explicit inclusion/deferment decisions. Catalogue completeness is never inferred from shared engine count.
roadmapPhases.deferred: Unapproved report variants remain blocked/unavailable; automated report distribution and arbitrary audit/payroll exports are not mandatory without signed inclusion. No second renderer/API/reporting architecture.

roadmapPhases.title: Per-provider integrations and external acceptance
roadmapPhases.dependencies: Start D11–D14 contracts/onboarding now, in parallel; implementation only from approved capability specs. Financial/clinical/consent/identity and recovery primitives accepted first. Production approvals remain separate from sandbox.
deliverables: Each included bank/M-Pesa/card/disbursement operation implemented from its own authorized spec, with secure credential custody and callback/unknown-outcome recovery. KCB/Equity HEALTH token checks are not transaction adapters.
Britam direct or explicitly authorized gateway and each other insurer independently accepted; SHA/eClaims/AfyaLink/SHR and KHIS/DHIS2 requirements separated by real capability/profile.
Operational SMS/email provider transport/delivery outcomes and required website booking site configured and accepted, not enabled by variable presence alone.
tests: Contract/mocked unit tests first, then authorized provider sandbox normal/negative/timeout/duplicate/replay/invalid-signature/credential-revocation/environment-isolation cases.
Provider references/acknowledgments retained with scope; rejected/unknown outcomes recover without blind retry; only verified exact settlement creates receipt, never mock or claim advice.
Accepted national indicator/form payload and correction acknowledgments; private manual decisions clearly distinguished from provider electronic decisions.
roadmapPhases.exit: Each included operation has required official spec, executed sandbox evidence and named provider/client acceptance; production activation only through separately authorized deployment/go-live process. Missing transport code remains missing even when credentials arrive.
roadmapPhases.deferred: Uncontracted providers/capabilities explicitly excluded; no guessed endpoints, banking passwords/OTP handling, screen scraping or synthetic/live mixing.

roadmapPhases.title: Production readiness, facility onboarding and final same-revision acceptance
roadmapPhases.dependencies: All included requirements in phases1–6 closed or formally contractually deferred; D04/D15 host/security/data-controller approvals, RPO/RTO/SLOs, supported devices and training owners. Optional OPT-001 not a blocker absent signed change order.
deliverables: Current101-chain fresh-install and supported-upgrade/drift proof with exact checksums/contracts; no unauthorized production DB inspection/mutation.
Authorized staging deployment/runtime/HTTPS/proxy/storage/migration/rollback rehearsal with known revision.
Current-schema/document-byte off-host backup/restore, separated/recoverable keys, scheduling/retention and measured recovery objectives.
Actionable monitoring/metrics/alerts/on-call ownership; fault recovery/load/soak evidence under agreed clinical/finance workload.

Responsive/mobile/keyboard/accessibility/printer supported-role acceptance; tenant/facility/module/subscription/invitation onboarding, professional verification where required, training/support/handover documentation.
Final signed requirement-to-test-to-output/provider/deployment pack; retain unresolved/deferred obligations rather than delete them.
tests: Full required CI at exact candidate with all mandatory DB assertions; repeatable fresh Docker bootstrap and safe prior-version upgrade.

Restore into separate empty disposable environment: row/content hashes, original binary bytes, ledger/stock balances and immutable audit agree; host/key loss and alert receipt drills meet approved RPO/RTO.

All11 workflows normal authenticated browser+API+PG journeys and owner scenario sign-offs at same revision; provider/host evidence separately identified; production pilot only if separately authorized.
roadmapPhases.exit: Named clinical, nursing, lab, radiology, pharmacy, finance, procurement, records, administration, security/privacy and IT owners sign the agreed scope at exact deployed revision; no unresolved required Critical/High defects/gaps; support/recovery custody transferred. Completion against original contract can only be asserted once D01/D02 scope evidence is resolved.
roadmapPhases.deferred: Optional OPT-001 advanced matching/forecast/scheduled distribution needs separate signed change order. No claim of regulatory certification or live operation from this roadmap, Git push, passing mocks or a synthetic approval.
